name: Octopus
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2 and Stealth +6. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A small russet octopus with a round mottled mantle and curling, sucker-lined arms.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 365. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775830-octopus
sections.Traits:
Compression. It can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Water Breathing. It breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 Bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Ink Cloud (1/Day). When a creature ends its turn within 5 ft. of the octopus while underwater, the octopus fills a 5-ft. cube centered on itself with ink and moves up to its Swim Speed. The cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect clears the ink.

name: Owl
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +5 and Stealth +5. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A tawny owl with a pale heart-shaped face, speckled folded wings, and small yellow talons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 366. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775831-owl
sections.Traits: Flyby. When flying out of an enemy’s reach, the owl does not provoke an Opportunity Attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions: Talons. +3 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 Slashing damage.

name: Panther
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +4 and Stealth +7. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Languages none.
appearance: A low, muscular black cat with rounded ears, powerful forepaws, and a long curved tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 366. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775832-panther
sections.Actions: Rend. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. As a Bonus Action, choose Disengage or Hide.

name: Piranha
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 8. No listed skills. Languages none.
appearance: A single deep-bodied silver fish with a rusty belly, a blunt toothed jaw, and a forked tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 366. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195160-piranha
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. It breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft. It has Advantage on this attack if the target is below its maximum HP. On a hit, deal 1 Piercing damage.

name: Plesiosaurus
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3 and Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses. Languages none.
appearance: A slate-backed marine reptile with a long arched neck, small head, four tapered flippers, and a short tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 366. The volume uses the revised 2024 fifth-edition rules and was released in 2025. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195166-plesiosaurus
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Bite. +6 to hit in melee, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
